# Welcome to the MasterRunners Page.

MasterRunners is a free-to-play multiplayer hand based movement game surrounding a variety of entertaining gamemodes, cosmetics, obstacles, etc.

With over **9+ gamemodes** and an **active player count of 100,000+**, we guarantee this game is worth your time. We have lots to offer, so what are you waiting for!?

# What you can do:

- Play Gamemodes with players across the **WORLD**. MasterRunners can be played worldwide and with our **advanced multiplayer system**, you can enjoy multiplayer & have a very fun time. For the gamemodes, we build special gamemodes that have never been used in others games making us stand out and more fun.
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/86601733_440204885645778_2463045873846786554_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=apUObDam7b4Q7kNvgFI3UUQ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr6-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDtP8BklgYQaD7Rd_rj5R6GmO2Ki-Pn9K6a-OoD62BAdA&oe=6728B38E)
- Chill with friends and have a **great time.** With areas such as the "Main Hub", you can relax and have a calming time with buddies as you talk to your hearts desire.
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lhr8-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982492_509486201534965_7333984808768808414_n.png?_nc_cat=101&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=r2RuoZmdcz8Q7kNvgECIfc2&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr8-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB1VGfHK4Q68667NZAT8c8h8GqYv_swkyqbxbohsQM6Gw&oe=67289B27)
- Shop for new cosmetics at Gregson's Shop with the free in-game currency... Energy! Using energy, you can get all kinds of cosmetics of any type just with one click. This is how you can customize your character!
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982613_1216230169384631_6163698231671476667_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=wy3cJfGxBKEQ7kNvgFKi1at&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBW6OFCwHg4QIep6kR72lG29khAwejf-NwKjHDxe0G78A&oe=67289375)

- **Survive Monsters..**
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974658_770419331698632_3320560763268773557_n.png?_nc_cat=107&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=q5aVrKjTcxEQ7kNvgHUk0_o&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lhr8-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC-aMXqhdlq7ObAU9A4KrcUHIiQYZc1Y3G6EzSQoQjq1g&oe=6728A167)

And more. 

There is lots to do in MasterRunners, so check it out **TODAY!**
